parameters.query:
SELECT 
    t.id AS Num_Chamado,
    e.name AS Cliente,
    e.id AS Entidade,
    
    CASE
        WHEN t.type = 1 THEN 'Incidente'
        WHEN t.type = 2 THEN 'Requisição'
    END AS TipoChamado,

    t.name AS Titulo,
    CASE 
        WHEN t.solvedate > t.time_to_resolve THEN 'Violação'
        ELSE 'Normal'
    END AS Situacao,
    
    ct.completename AS Categoria,

    (SELECT CONCAT(u.firstname, ' ', u.realname)
     FROM glpi_tickets_users tu
     INNER JOIN glpi_users u ON tu.users_id = u.id
     WHERE tu.type = 1 AND tu.tickets_id = t.id
     LIMIT 1) AS Requerente,

    -- Técnico
    (SELECT CONCAT(u.firstname, ' ', u.realname)
     FROM glpi_tickets_users tu
     INNER JOIN glpi_users u ON tu.users_id = u.id
     WHERE tu.type = 2 AND tu.tickets_id = t.id
     LIMIT 1) AS Tecnico,

    t.date AS DataHoraAbertura,
    t.time_to_resolve AS tempoParaResolver,
    t.solvedate AS DataHoraSolucao,
    t.closedate AS DataHoraFechamento,

    -- Tempo em segundos (base)
    COALESCE((
        SELECT SUM(tt.actiontime)
        FROM glpi_tickettasks tt
        WHERE tt.tickets_id = t.id
    ), 0) AS Tempo_Trabalhado_Segundos,

    -- Tempo formatado (HH:MM:SS)
    SEC_TO_TIME(
        COALESCE((
            SELECT SUM(tt.actiontime)
            FROM glpi_tickettasks tt
            WHERE tt.tickets_id = t.id
        ), 0)
    ) AS Tempo_Trabalhado_Formatado

FROM glpi_tickets t

INNER JOIN glpi_entities e 
    ON t.entities_id = e.id

LEFT JOIN glpi_itilcategories ct 
    ON t.itilcategories_id = ct.id

WHERE 
    t.is_deleted = 0
    AND t.entities_id =   {{ $json.body.contratoId }}  
    AND t.date BETWEEN '{{ $json.body.dataInicial }}' AND '{{ $json.body.dataFinal }}'

ORDER BY t.date ASC;

SELECT 
    COALESCE(ct.completename, 'Sem Categoria') AS Categoria,

    SUM(
        COALESCE((
            SELECT SUM(tt.actiontime)
            FROM glpi_tickettasks tt
            WHERE tt.tickets_id = t.id
        ), 0)
    ) AS Tempo_Total_Segundos,

    SUM(
        COALESCE((
            SELECT SUM(tt.actiontime)
            FROM glpi_tickettasks tt
            WHERE tt.tickets_id = t.id
        ), 0)
    ) / 3600 AS Tempo_Total_Horas,

    SEC_TO_TIME(
        SUM(
            COALESCE((
                SELECT SUM(tt.actiontime)
                FROM glpi_tickettasks tt
                WHERE tt.tickets_id = t.id
            ), 0)
        )
    ) AS Tempo_Total_Formatado

FROM glpi_tickets t

LEFT JOIN glpi_itilcategories ct 
    ON t.itilcategories_id = ct.id

WHERE 
    t.is_deleted = 0
    AND t.entities_id = {{ $json.body.contratoId }}
    AND t.date BETWEEN '{{ $json.body.dataInicial }}' AND '{{ $json.body.dataFinal }}'

GROUP BY ct.completename

WITH t1 as 
  (SELECT id, entities_id, completename
  FROM glpi_entities  
  WHERE entities_id IS NOT NULL and completename NOT LIKE '%INATIVOS%'),
  
t2 as 
  (SELECT entities_id, name, num
  FROM glpi_contracts  
  ),

  t3 as (
  SELECT t1.id, completename, num AS Horas_Contratadas
  FROM t1 INNER JOIN t2
  ON t1.id = t2.entities_id
  ORDER BY name
  ),

t4 as (
SELECT 
    e.id AS id,
    
    SUM(
        COALESCE(tt.actiontime, 0)
    ) /3600 AS Horas_Trabalhadas

FROM glpi_tickets t

INNER JOIN glpi_entities e 
    ON t.entities_id = e.id

LEFT JOIN glpi_tickettasks tt 
    ON tt.tickets_id = t.id

WHERE 
    t.is_deleted = 0    
    AND t.date BETWEEN '{{ $json.data_inicio }}' AND '{{ $json.data_fim }}'

GROUP BY e.id

),

t5 as (
SELECT 
  id, 
  TRIM(SUBSTRING_INDEX(completename, '>', -1)) AS name,
  Horas_Contratadas, 
  Horas_Trabalhadas, 
  Horas_Trabalhadas / Horas_Contratadas * 100 AS Percentual
FROM t3 NATURAL JOIN t4
WHERE Horas_Contratadas > 0
ORDER BY id
)

SELECT *
FROM t5

WITH t1 as 
  (SELECT id, entities_id, completename
  FROM glpi_entities  
  WHERE entities_id IS NOT NULL and completename NOT LIKE '%INATIVOS%'),
  
t2 as 
  (SELECT entities_id, name, num
  FROM glpi_contracts  
  ),

  t3 as (
  SELECT t1.id, name, completename, num AS Horas_Contratadas
  FROM t1 INNER JOIN t2
  ON t1.id = t2.entities_id
  ORDER BY name
  ),

t4 as (
SELECT 
    e.id AS id,
    
    SUM(
        COALESCE(tt.actiontime, 0)
    ) /3600 AS Horas_Trabalhadas

FROM glpi_tickets t

INNER JOIN glpi_entities e 
    ON t.entities_id = e.id

LEFT JOIN glpi_tickettasks tt 
    ON tt.tickets_id = t.id

WHERE 
    t.is_deleted = 0    
    AND t.date BETWEEN '{{ $json.data_inicio }}' AND '{{ $json.data_fim }}'

GROUP BY e.id

),

t5 as (
SELECT id, name, completename, Horas_Contratadas, Horas_Trabalhadas
FROM t3 NATURAL JOIN t4
WHERE Horas_Contratadas > 0
ORDER BY id
)

SELECT *
FROM t5
